title: Weekly Product Changelog: Nov 2, 2026
summary: Added More you can do and see from integration previews. You can now make more edits to your integrated tasks. See everything that's new in Integration

Added


- More you can do and see from integration previews.


You can now make more edits to your integrated tasks. See everything that's new in[Integration Previews 2.0](https://roadmap.sunsama.com/changelog/integration-previews-20)
- Sunny can do more for you. She can now log or adjust the time you've tracked on a task, create backlog folders, and delete a single subtask. Each change has an Undo.


Improved


- A faster calendar.


Sunsama now fits your tasks into your day 2–5× faster. Google and Outlook calendars only refresh what changed when you come back to the app.
- A smarter Autoplan.


If you start Autoplan late in the day, it asks whether to plan tomorrow or extend today. It no longer adds a task for something you've already blocked time for on your calendar. It can plan tasks into your focus blocks. It keeps meeting prep ahead of the meeting.
- Cleaner search.


A repeating task now shows up once, as its next copy.
- A refreshed Sunny chat window. It has clearer New chat and History buttons, and the send button now sits inside the input.


Fixed


- Calendar times for British Columbia no longer show an hour early, now that British Columbia has stopped changing its clocks.
- Sunny is more reliable when reordering your day, creating recurring tasks, setting due dates (west of UTC) and working with Google or Outlook events.
- Marking a task incomplete in Sunsama now reopens it in Google Tasks, Microsoft To Do, Trello and Planner. Completing a To Do task now also checks off its steps.
- Moving or editing an iCloud event no longer shows a false "Error updating event."
- Outlook threads no longer show the same message twice.
- Search no longer shows "No matches" if you pause before typing the last letter.
